title: SQL built by concatenation (groovy) — review required
description: A groovy query call assembles SQL from parts: .executes*([^)]*+. If any part is untrusted input, the query structure itself is attacker-controlled. This lexical rule flags the assembly; the reviewer confirms every part is trusted or parameterizes it.
remediation: Parameterize with GString with parameters so input stays data; never interpolate values into SQL text.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any concatenated query matches, including trusted assembly. Input trust needs human review.
